title: Wasted large language models: A life cycle thinking approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.17055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are machine learning (ML) models that have an increasingly large carbon footprint through their development and use. Efforts to increase the energy efficiency of these models have not translated into reduced consumption due to rebound effects such as Jevons Paradox - that increased efficiency drives increased use. There is therefore a need for additional measures to solve this problem.   We suggest that one possible way forward is to use life cycle thinking, and view LLMs as products that can become waste. With this perspective, we investigate the potential of the waste hierarchy from the EU's Waste Framework Directive, which suggests five different measures for how to manage waste: prevention, reuse, recycling, recovery, and disposal. translated_title: 浪费的大型语言模型：一种生命周期思维方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是机器学习（ML）模型，其开发和使用的碳足迹日益增大。提高这些模型能效的努力并未转化为消耗的减少，原因是反弹效应，如杰文斯悖论——效率提高导致使用增加。因此，需要额外措施来解决这一问题。我们建议，一种可能的出路是采用生命周期思维，将LLMs视为可成为废物的产品。基于此视角，我们探讨了欧盟废物框架指令中的废物层级，该指令提出了五种管理废物的措施：预防、再利用、回收、能量回收和处理。我们研究了这些措施如何启发和推动减少LLM废物及其总体环境影响的新思维和方法。应用废物层级思维，我们旨在为LLM的可持续发展提供新视角。
tldr: 本文提出将大型语言模型视为可产生废物的产品，通过欧盟废物框架的层级措施（预防、再利用、回收等）来减少其环境影响，这是首次用生命周期思维系统应对LLM的浪费问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes viewing large language models as waste-generating products and applies the EU waste hierarchy (prevention, reuse, recycling, etc.) to reduce their environmental impact, marking a novel life-cycle thinking approach to address LLM waste.
